P1_secondary_flow.statement: (secondary, deviation arm) same as P1 for full-batch GD at lr=0.002 (gradient-flow proxy).

P4.statement: P-SGD and P-Adam: no prediction (Ziyin & Chuang self-balancing question); outcome reported.
